result.quote: he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.
result.reason: Verse 26:4 directly and uniquely identifies doing what was right in the LORD’s eyes as the way Uzziah followed Amaziah’s example. Seeking God is mentioned in verse 26:5 but is not connected there to Amaziah’s example. The edited item is clear and valid, but it narrows the original source pair’s intended answer scope, which included both doing right and seeking God.
